statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains low during the weekend closure; Stress remains high because Hormuz restrictions and Friday's hawkish rate repricing leave reopening-gap uncertainty unresolved.
recommendation: The published state remains low Tail with high headline and reopening-gap Stress; no live NQ price path is available to establish persistent one-way behavior.
headline: Weekend closure keeps Tail low while Hormuz and rate risks sustain Stress
body: NQ is closed for the weekend. Friday's Nasdaq fell 0.52% after Fed Chair Kevin Warsh reinforced the inflation fight, while fresh Reuters reporting shows Iran's economy under sanctions pressure and Hormuz shipping restrictions still constraining traffic. These factors support high Stress without live evidence of persistent mean-reversion failure.
